footnotes.text: With prev AND next pointers, a node can unlink itself in O(1) - no search needed. That's why the list must be doubly linked.
Store the key inside each node - when evicting from the list you need it to delete the map entry too.

steps.t: A hash map for O(1) lookup, plus a doubly linked list for O(1) reordering.
Two sentinels: left.next is the least recently used node, right.prev the most recent.
